ayushman_bharat.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ayushman_bharat.description: Provides cashless and paperless health insurance coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization to poor, vulnerable, and entitled families.

rural_deprivation_criteria: only one room with kucha walls and kucha roof
no adult member between ages 16 to 59
households with no adult male member between ages 16 to 59
disabled member and no able-bodied adult member
landless households deriving a major part of their income from manual casual labour
urban_occupational_categories: other service provider working on streets

employment: government managed non agricultural enterprises worker

ddu_gky.scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
ddu_gky.description: A placement-linked skill training program targeted at rural poor youth to equip them with industry-relevant skills and secure sustainable employment with regular monthly wages.

alternative_eligibility_criteria_any_one: youth from mgnrega worker households with at least 15 days of work in the previous financial year
youth from a household with an active rsby card mentioning their details
youth from households issued antyodaya anna yojana or bpl pds cards
youth from a household where a family member is a member of an nrlm self help group
youth from a household covered under socio economic caste census auto inclusion parameters

exclusion_triggers.age_exclusion: anyone outside the 15-35 bracket unless they qualify under the special group extended age limit up to 45

mgnrega.scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
mgnrega.description: An employment scheme guaranteeing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

vulnerable_groups_special_provisions: senior citizens above 65 years of age

exclusion_triggers.location_exclusion: districts that have a hundred percent urban population

nsap_ignoaps.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
nsap_ignoaps.description: A centrally sponsored social assistance scheme that provides a monthly pension to senior citizens belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.

poverty_status: destitute with little or no regular means of subsistence

exclusion_triggers.economic_exclusion: households not classified under the below poverty line list
exclusion_triggers.duplicate_benefit_exclusion: individuals already receiving a pension or financial assistance from any other source

pm_kisan.description: An income support scheme that provides financial assistance to all cultivable landholding farmer families across the country to supplement agricultural inputs and domestic needs.

eligibility_triggers.land_requirements: must have cultivable land holding in their names, irrespective of the size of the land holding (no upper hectare limit)

exclusion_triggers.institutional_land_holders: any institutional land holder is excluded
political_or_constitutional_status: former and present holders of constitutional posts
former and present ministers or state ministers
former and present members of lok sabha, rajya sabha, state legislative assemblies, or state legislative councils
former and present mayors of municipal corporations
former and present chairpersons of district panchayats
exclusion_triggers.employment_status_exclusion: all serving or retired officers and employees of central or state government ministries, departments, field units, central or state pseas, attached offices, autonomous institutions, or regular employees of local bodies (excluding multi tasking staff, class iv, or group d employees)
exclusion_triggers.pension_exclusion_exceptions: multi tasking staff, class iv, and group d employees are exempt from the pension exclusion rule
exclusion_triggers.taxpayer_status: anyone who paid income tax in the last assessment year (or has a spouse/family member who paid income tax)

pm_ujjwala.description: A flagship scheme to make clean cooking fuel (LPG) available to poor and deprived households, replacing traditional health-detrimental cooking fuels like firewood and coal.

eligibility_triggers.household_status: must belong to a poor household without an existing active LPG connection
eligible_categories_any_one: belongs to sc or st households
beneficiary of pradhan mantri awas yojana (pmay)
certified poor household via a signed 14 point declaration

special_provisions.migrant_families: special documentation relaxation using self-declaration (Annexure I) to serve as proof of family composition and address

exclusion_triggers.gender_exclusion: male members from a household cannot apply
exclusion_triggers.existing_connection_exclusion: any household that already has an active lpg connection is excluded
exclusion_triggers.age_exclusion: minor women (under 18 years of age) are excluded

pmay_gramin.description: A flagship rural housing mission aimed at providing a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses in rural areas.

eligibility_triggers.housing_status: houseless households or households living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha walls and kutcha roofs
deprivation_scoring_parameters: households with no adult member between ages 16 to 59
female headed households with no adult male member between ages 16 to 59
households with no literate adult above 25 years
households with any disabled member and no able bodied adult member
landless households deriving the major part of their income from manual casual labor
tie_breaker_priority_groups: households with widows and next of kin of members of defence, paramilitary, or police forces killed in action
households where a member is suffering from leprosy or cancer and people living with hiv
households with a single girl child
beneficiary families of the forest rights act 2006

exclusion_triggers.housing_exclusion: all households living in houses with pucca roofs and or pucca walls, or living in houses with more than 2 rooms
registered_enterprises: non agricultural enterprises registered with the government
agricultural_land_exclusions: owning 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land with at least one irrigation equipment
owning 5 acres or more of irrigated land for two or more crop seasons
owning at least 7.5 acres of land or more with at least one irrigation equipment
